title: Mike Turner and aerospace donors removed the eminent domain provision
place_text: U.S. House; Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Dayton, Ohio

tellings.quote: my understanding of the behind the scenes what might have happened is Mike Turner

plain: Michels says that in 2023 a congressman named Mike Turner, with aerospace donors behind him, may have had an eminent domain provision removed from a UFO bill, a clause that would have let the government take over recovered non-human technology held by private companies. He frames it as his own "understanding of the behind the scenes, what might have happened," and also names Mike Johnson. If true, it would mean defence companies worked to keep control of such material out of public hands.
